title: Codex Pricing 2026: What It Costs and Which Plan to Use | No Code MBA

facts.fact: Codex is included in ChatGPT Plus at $20 per month, according to the vendor-linked article.
facts.quote: included in ChatGPT Plus ($20/month), Pro ($100, $200 or $500/month), Business and Enterprise

facts.fact: ChatGPT Pro tiers that include Codex are priced at $100, $200 and $500 per month.
facts.quote: Pro tiers run $100, $200 and $500/month with more usage as you go up

facts.fact: The Business Standard seat is listed at $25 per user per month, or $20 per user per month on annual billing.
facts.quote: $25/user/month ($20 annual) Standard; $125 ($100 annual) Premium

facts.fact: The Business Premium seat is listed at $125 per user per month, or $100 per user per month on annual billing.
facts.quote: $125 ($100 annual) Premium

facts.fact: The article states that Business Premium seats have 5 times the Codex usage of Standard seats.
facts.quote: Premium has 5x the usage of Standard

facts.fact: The article states that Business requires at least two seats.
facts.quote: Business needs at least two seats and can mix Standard and Premium

facts.fact: With an API key, Codex is billed only for tokens used, at OpenAI API prices, with no fixed monthly fee.
facts.quote: pay only for the tokens it uses, at OpenAI API prices

facts.fact: Plus at $20 per month totals $240 over twelve months, according to the article.
facts.quote: Plus at $20 is $240 over twelve months.

facts.fact: The article gives annual costs of $1,200 for Pro 100, $2,400 for Pro 200 and $6,000 for Pro 500.
facts.quote: Pro 100 at $100 is $1,200 per year, Pro 200 is $2,400, and Pro 500 is $6,000.

facts.fact: The article states that moving from Plus to Pro 100 adds $80 per month, or $960 per year.
facts.quote: The jump from Plus to Pro 100 is $80 per month or $960 per year

facts.fact: The article says Pro 100, Pro 200 and Pro 500 currently have no five-hour usage limit, though they still have an included overall allowance.
facts.quote: Pro 100, Pro 200 and Pro 500 currently have no five-hour limit, but still have an included usage allowance

facts.fact: Enterprise pricing is listed as custom rather than a fixed price.
facts.quote: | Enterprise | Custom |

facts.fact: OpenAI states that ChatGPT Work and Codex share the same usage, pricing, credits and limits.
facts.quote: OpenAI says ChatGPT Work and Codex share usage, so Work tasks inside ChatGPT draw on the same pricing, credits and limits.

facts.fact: ChatGPT credits can extend Codex usage on Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise plans once the plan allowance is used.
facts.quote: credits extend usage on Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise plans

facts.fact: The article lists GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6.1 Terra, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna as Codex models in OpenAI's current guide, with availability depending on account and plan.
facts.quote: OpenAI's current Work and Codex guide lists GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6.1 Terra, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna.

facts.fact: There is no separate Codex subscription; Codex is included in ChatGPT Plus at $20/month.
facts.quote: There is no separate Codex subscription. It is included in ChatGPT Plus at $20/month, Pro at $100, $200 or $500/month

facts.fact: Codex is included in ChatGPT Pro at $100 per month, as stated on the page.
facts.quote: It is included in ChatGPT Plus at $20/month, Pro at $100, $200 or $500/month, and Business and Enterprise plans.

facts.fact: Codex is included in ChatGPT Pro at $200 per month, as stated on the page.
facts.quote: Pro at $100, $200 or $500/month, and Business and Enterprise plans.

facts.fact: With a Codex API key, users pay per token rather than a flat subscription.
facts.quote: With an API key you pay per token.

facts.fact: Free ChatGPT accounts include limited Codex access, and regular use requires a paid ChatGPT plan or an API key.
facts.quote: Free ChatGPT accounts include limited Codex access. For regular use you need a paid ChatGPT plan or an API key.

facts.fact: ChatGPT credits can extend Codex usage once a user reaches the plan limit on Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise.
facts.quote: ChatGPT credits extend usage once you reach your plan limit on Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise.

facts.fact: API-key use of Codex covers the CLI, SDK and IDE extension but not cloud-based features such as GitHub code review or Slack integration.
facts.quote: API-key use covers the CLI, SDK and IDE extension, but not cloud-based features like GitHub code review or Slack integration.

facts.fact: OpenAI states that ChatGPT Work and Codex share usage, so heavy use of one reduces what remains for the other.
facts.quote: OpenAI says ChatGPT Work and Codex share usage, so heavy use of one reduces what is left for the other.

facts.fact: The page states that Plus at $20 per month includes Codex and a Pro tier is only needed if limits are hit regularly.
facts.quote: Plus at $20 per month includes Codex. Move to a Pro tier only if you hit limits regularly.
